# Overall Project Summary: Jul 17, 2026

Development on July 17 focused on strengthening agent autonomy and system reliability, highlighted by the implementation of a gated lane planner and hardened web research tools. The team also successfully addressed critical cloud infrastructure stability issues and introduced new observability features for account management.

## ✅ Completed Work

**Agent Orchestration & Coding Tools**
*   Enhanced agent autonomy by implementing a gated lane planner, background shell session management, and hardened `WEB_FETCH`/`WEB_SEARCH` actions ([elizaos/eliza#16454](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16454), [elizaos/eliza#16495](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16495)).
*   Improved coding agent performance through curated memory and recurring PR shepherd tasks ([elizaos/eliza#16536](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16536)).

**Cloud Infrastructure & Voice Services**
*   Resolved critical cloud deployment failures, including 503 errors in STT and voice bridge issues, while improving provider selection and node persistence ([elizaos/eliza#16487](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16487), [elizaos/eliza#16548](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16548)).
*   Expanded voice capabilities with opt-in Deepgram batch STT support ([elizaos/eliza#16525](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16525)).

**Account Management & UI Polish**
*   Increased system observability by deploying a new command-center table and consumer metering ([elizaos/eliza#16399](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16399)).
*   Optimized account pool strategies and refined UI components for settings and wallet views to improve user experience ([elizaos/eliza#16488](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16488), [elizaos/eliza#16540](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16540)).

## 🏗️ Work in Progress

**New Pull Requests**
*   **elizaos/eliza**:
    *   [#16551](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16551) ci: proposal, changed-line coverage for surgical legacy fixes.
    *   [#16543](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16543) fix(orchestrator): separate generated scaffolds from agent residuals.
    *   [#16538](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16538) fix(ui): repair startup and scenario contracts.
    *   [#16534](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16534) feat(ui): add Steward companion email code login.
    *   [#16567](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16567) fix(core): drop similes claimed by multiple parents instead of first-writer-wins.
